# TICKET: TICKET-010 Multi-Strategy Analysis UI Enhancement
Status: Pending  <!-- Pending | Ready | In Progress | Review | Done -->

## User Story
As a Strategy Developer and Analyst,
I want to compare top-performing configurations across multiple strategies (ORB variants and strategy12.10.1) in a unified analysis view with time range filtering,
so that I can quickly identify the best overall strategy configurations and understand their performance across different time horizons.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] AC-1: **Multi-Strategy Comparison Chart**: The analysis page displays top 5 configurations from each of 3 strategies (2 ORB variants + strategy12.10.1) in a single cumulative equity curve chart with individual toggle controls for each line.
- [ ] AC-2: **Time Range Filtering**: Users can filter the displayed data by time range (1 month, 1 year, 4 years) with the chart updating dynamically to show only data within the selected range.
- [ ] AC-3: **Strategy Selection & Details**: Users can select a specific strategy configuration to view all existing detailed metrics (win rate, profit factor, drawdown stats, trade table) in an organized, collapsible details section.
- [ ] AC-4: **Data Conversion Scripts**: Scripts exist to convert new pipeline data format (from `data/pipeline/4yearpipe1s/stage2 - analysisResults/`) into the analysis UI format, outputting to a new subfolder in `data/analysis/` with manifest.json and config files.
- [ ] AC-5: **Manifest Schema Enhancement**: The manifest.json schema supports multiple strategies with strategy identification (strategy_id, strategy_name) per configuration, enabling the UI to group and display configurations by strategy.

## Tasks
<!--
CRITICAL STRUCTURE (BMAD-inspired):
- Two-tier tasks system
- Every TOP-LEVEL task MUST map to 1+ Acceptance Criteria using (AC: AC-#,...)
- Subtasks do NOT need AC mapping (they inherit from parent task)
-->

- [ ] Task 1: Enhance Manifest Schema & Data Structure (AC: AC-5)
  - [ ] Update `ConfigSummary` type to include `strategyId` and `strategyName` fields.
  - [ ] Update manifest.json structure to support multi-strategy configurations (group configs by strategy or add strategy metadata).
  - [ ] Ensure backward compatibility with existing single-strategy manifests.

- [ ] Task 2: Build Multi-Strategy Comparison Chart Component (AC: AC-1, AC-2)
  - [ ] Create new `MultiStrategyChart` component that accepts multiple strategy configs.
  - [ ] Implement toggle controls for each line (checkbox or legend click to show/hide).
  - [ ] Display top 5 configs per strategy (15 total lines max, color-coded by strategy).
  - [ ] Remove SMA line from chart (keep only cumulative P&L lines).
  - [ ] Add time range filter controls (1 month, 1 year, 4 years) with date range calculation.
  - [ ] Filter chart data based on selected time range.

- [ ] Task 3: Reorganize Details View with Strategy Selection (AC: AC-3)
  - [ ] Add strategy/configuration selector (dropdown or tabs) above details section.
  - [ ] Organize existing metrics into collapsible sections:
    - Summary Statistics (win rate, profit factor, etc.)
    - Drawdown Analysis
    - Trade Table
  - [ ] Ensure selected config's data loads correctly when switching strategies/configs.

- [ ] Task 4: Create Pipeline Data Conversion Script (AC: AC-4)
  - [ ] Create `scripts/convert-pipeline-to-analysis.js` script.
  - [ ] Script reads `results.csv` from pipeline run folders (e.g., `orb-retest-breakout-v2_1216_0236_239days/results.csv`).
  - [ ] Script identifies top 5 configurations per strategy from CSV.
  - [ ] Script re-runs backtests (or reads existing trade data) to generate:
    - `manifest.json` with multi-strategy structure
    - `config-{rank}-trades.json` files per config
    - `config-{rank}-daily.json` files per config
  - [ ] Script outputs to `data/analysis/{pipelinename}/` subfolder.
  - [ ] Handle strategy12.10.1 data from "Stepped SL Best Of" folder structure.

- [ ] Task 5: Update Analysis UI Main Component (AC: AC-1, AC-2, AC-3)
  - [ ] Refactor `analysis-ui.tsx` to load and display multi-strategy manifest.
  - [ ] Replace single-config chart with `MultiStrategyChart` component.
  - [ ] Add time range filter state and handlers.
  - [ ] Integrate strategy selection dropdown/tabs.
  - [ ] Update config data loading to work with multi-strategy structure.

- [ ] Task 6: Update Risk Metrics Script for Multi-Strategy Support (AC: AC-4, AC-5)
  - [ ] Update `scripts/analyze-risk-metrics.js` to support multiple strategies in a single run.
  - [ ] Modify CSV reading to group by strategy_id.
  - [ ] Generate manifest with strategy metadata per config.
  - [ ] Ensure output format matches new manifest schema.

## Dev Notes
- **Current System**: The analysis page (`/analysis/[pipelinename]`) currently displays top 3 configurations from a single strategy. Data is generated by `scripts/analyze-risk-metrics.js` which reads permutation CSV results.

- **Data Sources**:
  - ORB v2 runs: `data/pipeline/4yearpipe1s/stage2 - analysisResults/orb-retest-breakout-v2_*/results.csv`
  - Strategy 12.10.1: `data/pipeline/4yearpipe1s/stage2 - analysisResults/Stepped SL Best Of/permutationresults-11.csv`
  - May need to re-run analysis for strategy12.10.1 if data format differs.

- **Chart Library**: Currently using Recharts (`LineChart`). Consider if we need to switch or enhance for better multi-line toggle performance.

- **Time Range Calculation**: 
  - 1 month = last 30 trading days from end date
  - 1 year = last 252 trading days (or actual calendar year)
  - 4 years = all available data

- **Color Scheme**: Use distinct colors per strategy (e.g., ORB v2 = blue tones, ORB v2 variant = green tones, 12.10.1 = purple tones) with opacity variations for top 5 configs within each strategy.

- **Performance**: Consider lazy loading config detail data (trades, daily PnL) only when a config is selected to reduce initial load time.
